title: Blueprint
summary: Defines problem statement: manual black-box QA design skill for generating test cases, risks, and gate decisions. Scope includes skill distribution, artifact contracts, schemas, goldens. Excludes automated test frameworks and production SaaS configs. I/O contract specifies 7-step output chain (observations → risks → priorities → test cases → effort → gate → brief). Lists 12+ artifact types with JSON schemas. References artifact-contract.md for detailed I/O requirements.
